start_condition.parent_selection: Frozen v8 TRAIN top8, irrespective of validation comparison
start_condition.criterion: Independent full audit passed; finite v8 PPL >=8.25; all integrity guards passed

backend_policy.selection_basis: Only warp16 exactly matches both archived S16 and parent first-window NLL; full archived parent replay remains mandatory

ranking.rule: Per-group minimum raw NLL; fixed v5 table order ties; strict improvement; global(deltaNLL,layer,group,table order)
ranking.interpretation: Individual group deltas propose combinations; effects are not assumed additive
